facts.text: P Vinaccia (owner, applicant, acting through the architect) and Wellington City Council (authority) concern a CCC for alterations and additions to a house at 19 Kellsmere Crescent, Island Bay.
Matter 2 asks whether other items identified by the authority comply with Clauses E3 (Internal Moisture), F4 (Safety from Falling) and H1 (Energy Efficiency).

Several building consents were issued for the house, including SR 87035 in 2002 for alterations.
